notes.title: Attention Steam Deck / Linux Players - Force Proton!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It appears a recent Steam Deck update broke the native build of Pawnbarian - the game launches, but isn't playable. I can't check right now, but I assume the same is true for Linux on regular PCs. I'm figuring out a maintenance fix, but until then, you can get the game to work by forcing the use of Proton:

[b]⚙ icon / right click → Properties → Compatibility → Force [...] → choose Proton[/b] instead of Steam Linux Runtime, e.g. Proton 9.0-4

Apologies for the inconvenience. Thanks for dropping by to play Pawnbarian!

Cheers,
Jan

notes.notes:
...and I'm holding a record low 50% off sale to celebrate!

I have no surprise patches prepared, but as a small treat, check out this lovely piece I comissioned from my buddy [url=https://twitter.com/SquareAnon]SquareAnon[/url]. It's sized exactly to potentially serve as a 16:9 4K wallpaper.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35770431/084c20e7d438638024ead8314b2c07f67618c662.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35770431/084c20e7d438638024ead8314b2c07f67618c662.png]open full size[/url]

Pawnbarian matured and expanded a lot over the past year, got localized into 15 languages thanks to your generous contributions, and goes a long way towards letting me and my co-creators support ourselves and letting us pursue new creative endeavors. As always - thank you!

As I've consistently said, there are no more major content updates planned, but I'm never saying never. In the meantime, I hope Pawnbarian will continue to make you launch one more run™ once in a while, and be enjoyed by some new arrivals as well. It's a game I'm immensely proud of.

I'm slowly working towards some new turn-based, boardgame-inspired thingy, possibly even smaller in scale than Pawnbarian. There's a good chance I'll initially launch it as a work-in-progress, browser-playable demo, much like I did with Pawnbarian.

If you'd like to keep an eye out, there are a bunch of ways you can do that:

notes.title: 1.2.2 - Degrindification
notes.notes:
Progressing through Chains might've been a bit too grindy to begin with, but definitely became so with the new characters introduced in 1.2.0. This has been completely reworked. The chains still require unlocking, but it can now happen much faster.

[b]The highest unlocked Chain is now shared between all characters, and the required dungeons can be conquered by different characters.[/b]

To be clear, the difficulty itself is unchanged, and actually conquering the chains is still separate for each character (same for the achievements), but you can skip a bunch if you feel up to the challenge. Conquering a chain counts as conquering all the lower ones as well.

change: reworked chain progression, as explained above
change: player gets fully healed before entering the Gauntlet
change: menus have new crown icons that correspond to dungeons conquered for the currently selected character and chain
change: chains on the character select screen turn gold as they're conquered, instead of all being gold at Chain X
fix: game starting in a broken state if never launched through Steam

Cheers,
Jan

notes.title: 1.2.0 - New heroes, DLC bling, and more!
notes.notes:
Hello! Pawnbarian is almost exactly 6 months old today, and there's some fun stuff lined up for that.

Most importantly, 1.2.0 is a major content update, bringing [b]three new heroes[/b] into the game.
[list]
[*] The [b]Nomad[/b] fights using her deadly aim with a bow instead of a melee weapon.
[*] The [b]Capyzerker[/b] fuels his rage with pain, and enjoys improved healing to match.
[*] The [b]Mystic[/b] relies on supernatural blessings to stay away from harm.[/list]Each has an unique ability and a whole new playstyle to explore and master. Their decks are based on international chess, but each brings a single fairy (non-standard) chess piece into the mix, which complements both the mechanics and the theme.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WgJKOHn.png[/img]

Releasing alongside the free content patch is the [b]Support the Developers DLC[/b], which gives all your heroes a [b][strike]gaudy[/strike] snazzy gold coat of paint[/b]. This is purposefully a minor, purely cosmetic change. as I didn't want to nickel-and-dime you by splitting up content into DLC for what's ultimately still a small game. If you enjoy the work me and my two wonderful co-creators did - please consider blinging out your heroes!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1938870
Of course, you can disable the DLC if you want to throw some extra money our way, but don't like the new look.

Both the game and the [b]Original Soundtrack[/b] are 30% off for the week.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734720/Pawnbarian__Original_Soundtrack/
[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
new: all-new Nomad hero
new: all-new Capyzerker hero
new: all-new Mystic hero
new: chain 0, V and X achievements to match
new: Support the Developers DLC release
change: +1 loot track gold on all floors, as a gentle global buff for the player

[h1]A note about localization[/h1]
Pawnbarian relies on generous community translations, and the new content isn't fully localized in all the previously supported languages, using English placeholders where relevant. It's been translated into Polish, as well as Traditional & Simplified Chinese thanks to [b]AJiang[/b]. If you'd like to fill out the remaining content in one of the languages which are almost there, or help support a whole new language, check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1142080/discussions/0/3194740147288664564/]dedicated thread[/url]. Thanks!

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
Mobile version, full steam ahead!
Follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/_j4nw]Twitter[/url] and join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/VSGztJVzFp]Discord[/url] to keep an eye out for updates, and likely some playtests along the way. I'm also inevitably going to get started on another project sometime soon.

Hope you enjoy!
Jan

notes.title: Stand with Ukraine Bundle + new stuff
notes.notes:
Pawnbarian is part of the absolutely massive [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/stand-with-ukraine-bundle]Stand with Ukraine Bundle[/url], a charity bundle of games organized by Humble. 100% of the proceeds are going towards organizations dealing with the ongoing humanitarian crisis caused by the Russian invasion of Ukraine. This is a cause particularly close to me in a very literal sense - I live in Warsaw, Poland, mere hours of travel away from the atrocities commited by the Russian army, and minutes away from places where many of the millions of Ukrainians fleeing their country are currently living.

Anyone reading this probably already has Pawnbarian, but the bundle should still be a pretty amazing deal. You can also spread the word about it, and most importantly, please consider helping in ways other than just getting some viddy games for cheap. You can get started here: https://linktr.ee/razomforukraine

Here's to a free, independent, and peaceful Ukraine, and a kinder world for us all.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KcS1GKM.jpg[/img]
[i]NEVER AGAIN WAR - a monument at [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Westerplatte]Westerplatte[/url]. [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Westerplatte_Nigdy_Wiecej_Wojny.jpg]credit[/url][/i]



In some strictly game-related news, for all your escapist needs - a free content patch with three new characters is coming to Pawnbarian, and you can try them out right now. They're mechanically complete, just unfinished on the audio-visual side, and will probably have a balance pass or two. Join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/VSGztJVzFp]Discord[/url] and follow the instructions there to join the private-beta branch.

Cheers,
Jan

notes.title: Gamepad Support Beta Available
notes.notes:
Full gamepad support is now available in the beta test branch! Everything seems to work A-OK, but the whole underlying input system has been overhauled, including for keyboard & mouse, so I want it to go through a short testing period first.

Give it a spin, and please share any thoughts on it - even if it's just a "works fine", which is what I'm hoping for!

To switch to the beta branch:
- right click Pawnbarian in your Steam Library
- select Properties
- select Betas
- switch to "public-beta"

Select "none" instead to switch back to the main version of the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mRMehuE.png[/img]

I've been testing with an Xbox 360 controller, but any generic gamepad (and Steam Deck!) should work just fine. You can swap between K&M and gamepad at any time, the game will adjust accordingly.

A few limitations / not yet implemented features:
- Tutorial text doesn't account for gamepad use. High priority.
- Polish language version doesn't have the new strings translated. High priority.
- Gamepad input isn't rebindable. Medium priority.
- There are no button prompts during gameplay. Medium priority to have it as an option.
- Some non-crucial descriptions aren't available (loot, hearts, deck/discard). Low priority.

Cheers,
Jan

notes.title: What's Next? - a rough roadmap
notes.notes:
Pawnbarian has been out for 2 weeks now, and enough of a success that I can continue to be an indie game developer - thank you!!

As you've seen, I've been pushing out some quality of life tweaks and small bugfixes, and will continue to do so as stuff comes up. I wanted to give you some insight into the future of the game beyond those small patches.

[h2]Balance?[/h2]
On it! I'm generally very happy with how the launch balance held up, but there are some changes lined up, mostly related to the Chain progression.

[h2]Localization?[/h2]
For sure! The game is mostly prepared for it, and I'm currently implementing convenient support for fan translations. Officially included languages might take a while, but we'll get there.

[h2]Controller support?[/h2]
Yeah! It's high up there on my list of priorities.

[h2]Mobile version?[/h2]
Definitely coming! My current rough estimate for both Android and iOS versions is early next year (Q1-Q2 2022).

[h2]Nintendo Switch version?[/h2]
Would love to! I think Pawnbarian fits the Switch really well, and I don't foresee many technical difficulties with porting the game. However, the whole ordeal isn't nearly as straightforward as releasing on Steam or mobile. If you'd like to Bishop some Goblins on the Switch, it'd help a lot if you spread the word about the game - catching the attention of the right person is my best bet of speeding up the process.

[h2]Other console versions?[/h2]
Maybe! I don't feel like the Xbox and Playstation are a great fit for what's ultimately a low-tech digital boardgame, but if there's enough interest - why not?

[h2]More content?[/h2]
I hear you! I consider Pawnbarian to be a mostly complete experience, and want to keep its design lean and focused. That being said, thanks to the way it's structured, it's possible to add extra stuff without bloating what's already there, and some ideas are already crystallizing. Please don't expect anything, and you might just be pleasantly surprised. Wink wink.


Best of luck on the 5x5 chessboard, and please keep sharing feedback any way you find convenient! I might not always respond, but I do hear - and care about - every single bit. Pawnbarian wouldn't be what it is without your participation.

notes.title: Pawnbarian masterfully blends Chess-like rules with a puzzle-roguelike
notes.notes:
Pawnbarian is a dungeon crawling roguelike but not one you've played before. It's turn-based and tile-based but your movement is based on the rules of various Chess pieces you have in cards.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/10/pawnbarian-masterfully-blends-chess-like-rules-with-a-puzzle-roguelike

notes.title: 1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- changed "Click Again" prompts to timeout-based (so they're now usable with a touchscreen)
- changed Settings placeholder strings shown when the game starts in a broken state to something more useful
- fixed Shogun being able to make illegal moves after using Dragon Drop while having a card selected
- fixed Exit Portal sfx sometimes not playing

notes.title: 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- changed shogi piece icons to kanji + pattern instead of just kanji
(this is currently the only way; the old display might come back as an option in a future update)
- changed Spark Surge description to clarify that it only attacks the targeted squares like a normal attack
- fixed Spark sfx when a Cantrip card is selected continuing to play after abandoning the run

notes.title: 1.0.2 + 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1.0.2
- added "Restart Dungeon" button on the game over screen
- changed LMB to be the only button accepted for click inputs
- changed RMB to deselect current card (even when not hovering over it)
- fixed bizarre vertically-oriented resolutions being available on some monitors

1.0.3
- fixed newly introduced bug where using "Restart Dungeon" after dying on the boss floor or in the Gauntlet kept playing boss music for the entirety of the new run

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- fixed increased Life cost not being stored in saves
- fixed wacky board state being possible against Golem Fortress boss and miniboss

notes.title: New Demo, Tiny Teams 2021, Release News
notes.notes:
There's a new demo available to play! Some things got a major overhaul, and everything was touched up in one way or another. Additionally, for the first time ever, there's a native Mac version. This is a near-final state of the game, so there's never been a better time to tell a friend to check it out. Wink wink. 

Just like last year, Pawnbarian was selected for Yogscast Games' Tiny Teams festival, which launches right now! Over the next week, exclusively for the duration of the event, the second character - the Knight Templar - is unlocked in the demo.

https://yogsca.st/TinyTeams

Look around for other cool games made by small devs, and check out Pawnbarian on The Yogscast's stream on August 8 (that's tommorow) during the 19-22 UTC timeslot. (below times are in BST)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35770431/44ef3aefe5efde91eacfb1e14c4011d981e813ff.png[/img]

Finally, the game is very close to release! I don't have an exact date for you yet, but it's next month - [b]September 2021[/b].

Hope you enjoy, and I look forward to hearing your feedback.
Jan

notes.title: Have You Played Pawnbarian?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time…

A tiny and mighty game. Pawnbarian is a chessy rougelike with a bit of card-flinging deckbuilding thrown in. It’s a simple shuffle around the ancient black and white board of yore but with the tiniest sprinkle of new age videogamery. It’s real good, and it is free.
